sentences.en: Salt was a rare and costly commodity in ancient times.
sentences.zh: 在古代，盐是一种稀少且昂贵的商品。

sentences.en: I ran across a rare book in a secondhand bookstore.
sentences.zh: 我在旧书店偶然发现了一本珍稀书籍。

sentences.en: I found a rare book I had been looking for.
sentences.zh: 我终于在一个旧书店找到了我一直寻找的那本书。
